steps.cmd: node -e "const n=Date.now(),a=Date.parse('2026-10-03T01:00:00Z'),b=Date.parse('2026-10-05T01:00:00Z');if(n<a||n>b){console.log('Outside the Micro Jam 066 submission window (2026-10-03 01:00 to 2026-10-05 01:00, UTC assumed)');process.exit(1)}" && { test -f JAM-OK || { echo 'A person must: join the Micro Jam Discord (prize eligibility), open the Godot 4 editor with the Ziva plugin signed in (so its MCP server is reachable), copy the announced theme and prerequisite from https://itch.io/jam/micro-jam-066 into JAM-OK in funding/orchestrator/work/micro-jam-066, then resume this flow'; exit 1; }; }

steps.prompt: Target: Micro Jam 066: Toxic (https://itch.io/jam/micro-jam-066), category 'Best Games Made With Ziva' (5 PayPal prizes, $30 down to $10). Read JAM-OK for the theme and the prerequisite the person copied. Using WebFetch only, read the jam page and the Ziva docs linked from it. Write research.md with: the theme, the prerequisite, the submission rules (web build, #ziva tag, no file changes after the 6-hour grace period), what the Ziva category requires as proof that Ziva was used, the rating criteria (Overall, Art, Audio, Polish, Fun, Theme, Prerequisite), and three small game concepts that fit 'Toxic' and can be built in Godot 4 in under 12 agent hours. Pick one and say why. Reply with a 5-line summary.
steps.verify: test -s research.md && grep -qi 'prerequisite' research.md && grep -qi 'ziva' research.md

node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=fs.readFileSync('game/project.godot','utf8');if(!/config_version=5/.test(p))throw new Error('not a Godot 4 project');const h=fs.readFileSync('export/index.html','utf8');if(!/\.(pck|wasm)/.test(h))throw new Error('export/index.html does not load a Godot build');const f=fs.readdirSync('export');if(!f.some(x=>x.endsWith('.pck'))||!f.some(x=>x.endsWith('.wasm')))throw new Error('export is missing .pck or .wasm');const z=fs.readFileSync('ZIVA.md','utf8');if((z.match(/^[-*] /gm)||[]).length<5)throw new Error('ZIVA.md logs fewer than 5 Ziva actions');console.log('ok: Godot 4 web export + '+f.length+' files, Ziva log present')"

steps.cmd: rm -f web-build.zip && cd export && zip -qr ../web-build.zip . && cd .. && unzip -l web-build.zip | grep -q ' index.html$' && node -e "const s=require('fs').statSync('web-build.zip').size;console.log('web-build.zip '+s+' bytes');process.exit(s>0&&s<500*1024*1024?0:1)"

steps.prompt: Write SUBMISSION.md for the itch.io jam page: game title, a 2-paragraph description, controls, how it fits the theme and the prerequisite, a 'Made with Ziva' section summarising ZIVA.md, tags (must include ziva), and an AI-use note (the rules say 'Yes, AI is allowed.'). Add a 'Human checklist': play the web build for 5 minutes, create the itch.io project page (HTML, 'This file will be played in the browser' on web-build.zip), add the ziva tag, submit to Micro Jam 066 before the deadline, stay in the Discord, and keep a PayPal account for the payout. Do not submit anything. Reply with the title.
steps.verify: test -s SUBMISSION.md && grep -q 'Human checklist' SUBMISSION.md && grep -qi 'ziva' SUBMISSION.md
